notes.gn_btp_header_bytes: BTP-B (4 B) + GeoNetworking SHB: Basic Header 4 B + Common Header 8 B + SHB extended header 28 B (4 B + Long Position Vector 24 B, as in Vanetza ShbHeader). Verify against ETSI EN 302 636-4-1 / EN 302 636-5-1.
notes.cam_base_bytes: Signed CAM without low-frequency container, signer = certificate digest: ITS PDU header + basic + high-frequency containers + IEEE 1609.2 / TS 103 097 envelope. Fitted so that headers + base = 200 B, the smallest frequent CAM size in the Volkswagen traces (Molina-Masegosa et al., IEEE TVT 2020, doi:10.1109/TVT.2020.2979232).
notes.low_frequency_extra_bytes: Low-frequency container incl. path history. Volkswagen modes 360-200 = 160 B and 455-300 = 155 B; mean 158 B. Interpretation of the modes is ours, the sizes are measured.
notes.certificate_extra_bytes: Full certificate instead of its digest. Volkswagen modes 300-200 = 100 B and 455-360 = 95 B; mean 98 B, within the 100-150 B certificate size reported in the same paper.
notes.low_frequency_interval_s: ETSI EN 302 637-2: low-frequency container included if at least 500 ms passed since it was last included.
notes.certificate_interval_s: Certificate attached once per second or when a new neighbour is detected (Molina-Masegosa et al. 2020, citing C2C-CC profiles).
